description: This Java class 'CustomerDBUtil' provides database utility methods for managing Customer objects, including validation, retrieval, insertion, update, and deletion operations related to customer data in a database.

classes.name: CustomerDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for performing database operations related to Customer entities.

methods.name: validateCustomer
methods.description: Validates customer credentials by querying the database with email and password; returns a Customer object if found.

methods.name: getAllCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers from the database.

methods.name: insertCustomer
methods.description: Inserts a new customer record into the database with provided details.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details in the database based on customer ID.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record from the database based on customer ID.

methods.name: updateCustomerWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates customer details excluding the image URL.
